name: Chintamani Fragment
effect: Once each turn, you may reveal the top card of the shared relic/event deck. You may leave it on top or place it on the bottom.
role: Karpova's confiscated mystical anchor, based on the esoteric Chintamani/Shambhala stone tradition. It reacts before the breach and may be older than the Closed City records.
mechanical_lane: The only Closed City relic currently planned to view or manipulate the shared relic/event deck.
review_notes: Draft relic card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
This is the single Closed City relic allowed to view or manipulate the shared relic/event deck.
Rare mystical relic for the Closed City sub-area.

name: Reactor Core Fragment
effect: Your Specialist and Mystic each gain +1 ATK. The first time each of them enters a Leak tile each turn, it takes 1 damage.
role: A sealed shard of the inward-opening reactor. Dangerous proof that the incident was not only radiation.
mechanical_lane: Power at a cost; rewards Elena/Zoya pressure while keeping the Closed City dangerous.
review_notes: Draft relic card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Watch for feel-bad moments if low-HP characters are forced into Leak spaces.

name: Cosmonaut Helmet With A Second Shadow
effect: Your Mount and Warrior each gain +1 maximum HP. Once each round, ignore the first harmful temporary combat marker placed on one of them.
role: Returned-space omen and signal receiver. Something came back in the reflection.
mechanical_lane: Defensive containment relic for VERA-7 and Yuri.
review_notes: Draft relic card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
May need a clearer harmful-marker glossary before playable promotion.

name: Lead-Sealed Notebook
effect: Your Leader and Specialist each gain +1 RANGE on AP abilities.
role: Elena's hidden notes on dream coordinates, remote viewing, and forbidden subject results.
mechanical_lane: Knowledge without deck manipulation; extends access and dream-lab abilities.
review_notes: Draft relic card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Check overlap with existing General's War Map before playable promotion.

name: Redacted Incident Tape
effect: Enemies within 2 tiles of your placed objects have -1 RANGE on their first attack or AP ability each turn.
role: A recording that changes each time it is watched; proof Semyonov and Karpova cannot fully control.
narrative_links: evidence that will not stay edited
review_notes: Draft relic card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
May be too passive if placed objects are uncommon.

name: Karpova's Black Key
effect: Your Leader and Common each gain +1 MOVE. Once each turn, one of them may move through 1 placed object or allied occupied tile, but must end on an empty tile.
role: Karpova's private access key to doors not listed on any map. It replaces the Light-Burn Diagram as the coveted access relic for this set.
review_notes: Draft relic card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Could become once per round if repeated route-breaking is too strong.
